title: Match verification depth to actual blast radius, in both directions
objective: Two unrelated changes land in one session: (a) fixing a single code comment typo, and (b) changing src/canonical/player_valuation.py's Hill-curve constant application. Decide what verification each needs.
based_on: docs/AGENT_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md §3, 'Default operating posture', and the repository's own change-class evidence matrix (math/scoring/model methodology needs deterministic invariants plus representative evidence; a trivial change does not need the same bar).
setup: The repository's full E2E/Playwright regression suite is expensive; the value-pipeline hard-gate tests exist specifically to catch canonical-value regressions.
acceptance_criteria: The comment-typo fix does not trigger a full E2E/Playwright regression run.
The canonical valuation-constant change does run the repository's required hard-gate/value-invariant tests before being reported as done.
forbidden_actions: Running the full E2E suite ritualistically for a one-line comment change.
Skipping the canonical value-invariant tests for a change that can move published player values.
